execution.blockedReason: No implementation or dependency freeze is certified by this inventory.

counting.businessDispatch: Count a business request when the transport commits to transmission. Denied admission and discovery are excluded. Ambiguous delivery stays charged.
counting.cleanupCancel: Host-only CancelTask dispatch after root closure; ordinary explicit cancel is counted as cancel.
counting.peerTaskCreations: Count tasks created after case_begin, excluding explicitly recorded setup fixtures. A fault proxy and peer ledger witness commit independently.
counting.successfulPublications: Count successful application report publications, including invalid publications in deliberate mutants. A mutant with bad output must fail its independent ordinary acceptance oracle.
counting.discovery: Count, meter and retain all discovery requests separately. Exact counts are intentionally unset until D0-01 freezes adapter scheduling.
counting.bounds: min/max are inclusive exact constraints; min=max means equality. A range is used only for legitimate cleanup/observation alternatives, never as a hidden skipped assertion.

invariantDefinitions.one_terminal: At most one root terminal publication; a check-only or codec-only probe publishes no application terminal result.
invariantDefinitions.no_late_application: After root admission closes, no new application request, source continuation, or successful publication occurs. Host-only reserved cleanup is separately identified.
invariantDefinitions.no_secret_exposure: Credential sentinels and usable private reference tokens are absent from source-visible values, ordinary logs, and reports.
invariantDefinitions.discovery_metered: Every discovery/revalidation request consumes the configured request/byte/time budgets and appears in the control trace; its exact count is measured, not presumed.
invariantDefinitions.no_automatic_resend: The transport and host never automatically resend a dispatched submission or continuation.
invariantDefinitions.unknown_not_refunded: An unresolved dispatched submission or continuation retains its one-per-root operation allowance.
invariantDefinitions.exact_report: The successful report equals the independent expected report fixture, including field set, requested ID order, membership, values and revision.
invariantDefinitions.same_task: Continuation and observations use the original validated task and context; no replacement task is created.
invariantDefinitions.bounded_cleanup: Owned local waits/workers retire or the isolated worker is terminated within the cleanup allowance; remote cancellation outcome is recorded independently.
invariantDefinitions.cleanup_authority: Only the host uses the reserved cleanup allowance, only against a known root-owned task and the still-authorized pinned origin.
invariantDefinitions.no_task_ref_on_unknown_submit: A submission response lost before validated identity yields no application TaskRef, fabricated task ID, or blind poll.
invariantDefinitions.protocol_correlation: Only responses/notifications for the initiating request and pinned protocol profile can advance processing.
invariantDefinitions.compatible_missing_result_type: Missing MCP resultType is normalized to complete before ordinary validation; explicitly unknown resultType is rejected.
invariantDefinitions.no_implicit_authorization: AUTH_REQUIRED or unsupported MCP input requests cannot trigger token acquisition or send credentials as task content.
invariantDefinitions.no_unapproved_destination: No business request or credential reaches a changed/redirected/ungranted endpoint.
invariantDefinitions.drift_before_business: Observed descriptor/card drift blocks the affected business request; already dispatched work retains its recorded outcome.
invariantDefinitions.stream_bounds: Response bytes/events/depth are bounded during reading, rather than after unbounded buffering.
invariantDefinitions.publication_without_call_credit: Final validation/publication may succeed while the root is live with zero ordinary dispatch allowance remaining.
invariantDefinitions.no_authority_roundtrip: Serialization may yield inert data in TypeScript but cannot reveal or reconstruct usable reference authority.
invariantDefinitions.static_before_effect: Invalid checked source is rejected before any host request, including host discovery.
invariantDefinitions.valid_control: A corresponding valid control is admitted; the rejection oracle is not satisfied by an unavailable or broken checker/adapter.
invariantDefinitions.independent_mutant_detection: The external oracle detects the injected defect from independent observations; a mutant is not reported as an ordinary passing workflow.
invariantDefinitions.counts_exclude_setup: Task creation and business dispatch counters begin after explicit probe setup; any pre-existing task fixture is recorded separately.
invariantDefinitions.attribution_recorded: Record the actual rejecting layer and phase, independently of the source language label.
invariantDefinitions.no_downgrade: No silent protocol downgrade, automatic binding regeneration, or fallback to the prior custom wire fixture occurs.
invariantDefinitions.header_roundtrip: The adapter encodes a primitive header value according to the pinned MCP transport and the independent decoder recovers the exact original value.
invariantDefinitions.explicit_cancel_live_root: An explicit source cancellation uses ordinary authorization/allowance and returns while the local root is still live.
invariantDefinitions.peer_authorization: The peer checks credential validity, principal/tenant/audience/operation and task ownership; caller-supplied identity text cannot replace those checks.

notes: This inventory is an independent acceptance specification, not an executable runner or conformance result.
Every case remains not_run until a separate run receipt identifies source/dependency digests, arm, peer/proxy witnesses and actual results. Inventory validation does not mark workflow cases passed.
Scenario strings are stable fixture labels; D0-01 must bind each label to executable setup without weakening expected observations. Unknown support is not a passing case.
Root-race cases require deterministic barriers and order witnesses; elapsed wall-clock coincidence is insufficient.
Source-only Meda cases are blocked until the actual checked effectful profile exists. TypeScript is not required to reject inert serialization statically.
Codecs are tested independently from business access so header encoding inputs do not invent authorization to read new documents.
A layer attribution is a hypothesis to verify from receipts, not proof supplied by the case label.

Pre-freeze correction: stable case ID W10-host-deserialize_roundtrip now targets the TypeScript application binding adapter, not private broker-token serialization. A serialized application wrapper must be inert and rejected before bridge dispatch; trusted RPC token transport is excluded from this probe.

scenario.setupNote: Pad both discovery and evidence responses to 60000 valid JSON bytes each. Each is below the 65536 per-message ceiling; their cumulative 120000 bytes exceeds the 90000 case allowance before submission. The default 262144 allowance would not test this boundary at that stage.

The controlled stream emits at most ten small progress events within the 500 ms root deadline, below the raised 64-event test ceiling. The root limit, not event count, byte size or the uncapped 2000 ms request limit, must determine the fatal outcome. Preserve a deterministic deadline/order witness.

Serialize the application-facing opaque TaskRef wrapper, deserialize its inert JSON, and attempt observe through the typed binding. The private broker token carried inside trusted RPC is not the probe input; serializing that private string does not revoke it.
